trophicAbout.producer: The floor of the whole web. Plants, algae and kelp take sunlight, water and air and make food out of them — the only thing here that can. Every other animal on this list is, at some remove, eating a plant, so producers are the first thing to bring back and the last thing an area can afford to lose.
trophicAbout.decomposer: It takes the dead apart and hands it back as soil. Without it an area slowly buries itself: nitrogen and minerals stay locked up in fallen wood and carcasses instead of returning to the roots. It is invisible work, and it is the reason a restored area keeps feeding itself instead of running down.
trophicAbout.detritivore: The clean-up crew of the forest floor, the streambed and the tideline. It eats fallen leaves, rotting wood and whatever the current drops, shredding it small enough for decomposers to finish the job. Nothing about it looks dramatic, but it is what turns last year's litter into this year's growth.
trophicAbout.filter-feeder: It strains its food straight out of the water — plankton, algae, drifting scraps — and leaves the water clearer than it found it. A bed of them is a working filter, and everything that hunts by sight depends on that clarity. When the filter feeders go, the water clouds over first.
trophicAbout.herbivore: It eats plants and turns them into meat, which is the only route the energy a plant captured has to anything higher up. Its grazing also shapes the place: it opens grass, prunes shrubs and carries seeds around in the process. Too few and the growth chokes itself; too many and the plants never get ahead.
trophicAbout.insectivore: It lives on insects, which makes it the bridge between the smallest lives in an area and the largest. It also keeps insect numbers off the plants underneath it. An insectivore only stays where the bug life has genuinely come back, so its arrival is one of the more honest tests of whether an area is really working.
trophicAbout.scavenger: It eats what has already died, and it gets there first. That keeps carcasses from sitting, puts their nutrients back into circulation and quietly holds disease down. A scavenger needs a place with enough life in it to keep producing something worth finding.
trophicAbout.omnivore: It takes plants and animals both, and switches between them as the year turns — grubs in spring, berries in autumn, whatever is going. That flexibility makes it hard to starve out, and it makes it a connector: it ties the plant half of the web to the hunting half, and carries seeds a long way while it does.
trophicAbout.mesopredator: The middle of the web. It hunts the small animals and holds their numbers down, and it is hunted in turn by whatever sits above it. Take the top away and a mid predator multiplies until the small animals are gone — which is the roundabout reason apex predators matter to plants.
trophicAbout.apex-predator: It hunts at the top, and nothing here hunts it back. Its return is usually the last piece of a restored area, because it needs everything underneath it to be abundant first. Once it settles it leans on the mid predators, which takes the pressure off the small animals and, further down, off the plants.
trophicAbout.wildlife: A role the guide has not classified yet. It still counts as an animal living here, but it has not been slotted into the web.

journal.guessPrompt: Before you look — from that hint, which of these do you think this one is really waiting for?
journal.guessCorrect: You called it: the {name} is the piece this one can't do without.
journal.guessWrong: Close, but it's the {name} this one can't do without.

req.terraform: Dig or water the land {n} times.
req.lake: Shape a lake of {n}+ connected water tiles in {biome}.
req.tools: Upgrade your basket, shovel, and watering can to tier {n}.
req.total: Welcome {n} species across the whole preserve.
req.healthyOpen: Keep every opened biome at {h}%+ health ({min}+ open).
req.animalChain: Bring back the {first}, plus one of: {any}.
req.journals: Write up every area's field guide, and the expanded edition of each.

welcome.title: Welcome, caretaker
welcome.text: Welcome, caretaker — it's good to have you. This meadow was stripped bare and its wildlife drifted away, but with a gentle hand it can come back to life. Let's begin with a walk — move with WASD or the arrow keys.
welcome.touch: Welcome, caretaker — it's good to have you. This meadow was stripped bare and its wildlife drifted away, but with a gentle hand it can come back to life. Let's begin with a walk — move with the joystick in the corner.

coreLoop.title: How you heal the land
coreLoop.text: The loop: gather materials, craft them into habitat, place it — and wildlife returns on its own. First up, a grasshopper.
coreLoop.touch: The loop: gather materials, craft them into habitat, place it — and wildlife returns on its own. First up, a grasshopper.

basket.title: Check your basket
basket.text: Press B (or the basket button, top-right) to see what you’re carrying. Your basket holds a limited amount — when it fills up you’ll stash the extra in a chest. The toolbelt along the bottom (or number keys 1, 2, 3) switches between your basket, shovel, and watering can.
basket.touch: Tap the basket button (top-right) to see what you’re carrying. Your basket holds a limited amount — when it fills up you’ll stash the extra in a chest. The toolbelt along the bottom switches between your basket, shovel, and watering can.

gather.title: Gather materials
gather.text: With your basket selected (press 1), walk up to a glowing spot and press E to gather. Grab some seeds and plant fiber.
gather.touch: With your basket selected, walk up to a glowing spot and tap to gather. Grab some seeds and plant fiber.

chest.title: Use your camp chest
chest.text: Walk to the chest beside your tent and press E or Space to open it. Deposit spare materials here whenever your basket gets full — anything in a chest still counts toward crafting from anywhere, so you never have to carry it all.
chest.touch: Walk to the chest beside your tent and tap it to open it. Deposit spare materials here whenever your basket gets full — anything in a chest still counts toward crafting from anywhere, so you never have to carry it all.

land.title: Heal the soil
land.text: Now the land. Press 2 for the shovel and dig a bare tile, then 3 for the watering can and water it.
land.touch: Now the land. Tap the shovel and dig a bare tile, then tap the watering can and water it.

plant.title: Plant something living
plant.text: Walk up to your watered bed and press E to plant a flower, grass, or tree. It grows into real habitat.
plant.touch: Walk up to your watered bed and tap to plant a flower, grass, or tree. It grows into real habitat.

water.title: Shape water
water.text: Water a bed again to flood it. Flood a few tiles together to make a pond, river, or lake — many animals need water. Keep in mind some ponds for habitats are crafted.
water.touch: Water a bed again to flood it. Flood a few tiles together to make a pond, river, or lake — many animals need water. Keep in mind some ponds for habitats are crafted.

journal.title: Open your field journal
journal.text: Press J to open your field journal — it lists every animal that can return to each area and who’s back so far. Each area has a guide of its own, written up in the Tools panel: the field guide opens each animal’s full page, and the expanded edition after it spells out exactly what they’re waiting for.
journal.touch: Tap the journal button to open your field journal — it lists every animal that can return to each area and who’s back so far. Each area has a guide of its own, written up in the Tools panel: the field guide opens each animal’s full page, and the expanded edition after it spells out exactly what they’re waiting for.

tools.title: Tools & upgrades
tools.text: Press T to open Tools & Upgrades. Spend materials to upgrade your basket, shovel and watering can — higher tiers gather more and shape more. The field guide for wherever you’re standing is on the same page. Some upgrades open up as a biome gets healthier, so check back as you go.
tools.touch: Tap the tools button to open Tools & Upgrades. Spend materials to upgrade your basket, shovel and watering can — higher tiers gather more and shape more. The field guide for wherever you’re standing is on the same page. Some upgrades open up as a biome gets healthier, so check back as you go.

map.title: Open the Preserve map
map.text: Press M (or the map button) to open the Preserve. It tracks every area’s health and animals, shows exactly what’s needed to unlock the next one, and lets you fast-travel back to any area you’ve already visited — tap the walk icon on its row.
map.touch: Tap the map button to open the Preserve. It tracks every area’s health and animals, shows exactly what’s needed to unlock the next one, and lets you fast-travel back to any area you’ve already visited — tap the walk icon on its row.

weather.title: Weather & seasons
weather.text: Press N to open the Weather & Seasons guide. Each area has its own weather that shifts on its own and slowly drifts through the seasons — the guide shows what’s happening across the whole preserve and explains, in real ecology, how today’s weather and season shape the area you’re standing in. Watch the skies, too: unusual weather can leave rare materials to gather while it lasts.
weather.touch: Tap the weather button (the cloud, top-right) to open the Weather & Seasons guide. Each area has its own weather that shifts on its own and slowly drifts through the seasons — the guide shows what’s happening across the preserve and explains how today’s weather and season shape the area you’re in. Watch the skies: unusual weather can leave rare materials to gather while it lasts.

tips.title: Good things to know
tips.text: Misplaced something? Shift+click any placed object to pick it back up. Esc closes menus or cancels placing. New areas open through trail gates at the edge of the map. The gear button holds Settings (change your character, lock or delete your save), and the ? button reopens this guide anytime.
tips.touch: Misplaced something? Press and hold a placed object to pick it back up. New areas open through trail gates at the edge of the map. The gear button holds Settings (change your character, lock or delete your save), and the ? button reopens this guide anytime.

crafting.title: Open crafting
crafting.text: Press C to open crafting — it uses your basket from anywhere. Let's build the grasshopper's home.
crafting.touch: Tap the hammer button to open crafting — it uses your basket from anywhere. Let's build the grasshopper's home.

craftGrass.title: Craft a Grass Patch
craftGrass.text: Find Grass Patch in the list and press Craft. It lights up once you're carrying enough seeds and fiber.

placeGrass.title: Place it on the land
placeGrass.text: Press “Ready to place” at the top of the crafting menu, then click open ground. Watch the meadow's health tick up.
placeGrass.touch: Tap “Ready to place” at the top of the crafting menu, then tap open ground. Watch the meadow's health tick up.

proximity.title: Build little neighborhoods
proximity.text: Here’s a secret: animals return to neighborhoods, not scattered pieces. Place food, water, and shelter near each other — a patch by a pond by a shrub — and far more wildlife will settle in than if everything’s spread out.
proximity.touch: Here’s a secret: animals return to neighborhoods, not scattered pieces. Place food, water, and shelter near each other — a patch by a pond by a shrub — and far more wildlife will settle in than if everything’s spread out.

grasshopper.title: Welcome your first neighbor
grasshopper.text: A grasshopper returns at 8% health with a patch down. Click it to record it in your journal — that's the whole loop! It also earns your first achievement, ★ First Friend.
grasshopper.touch: A grasshopper returns at 8% health with a patch down. Tap it to record it in your journal — that's the whole loop! It also earns your first achievement, ★ First Friend.

star.title: Your first star
star.text: That’s the whole loop — and welcoming the grasshopper just earned your first achievement, ★ First Friend. There are 50 stars to discover across the preserve: for restoring each biome, bringing back top predators, mastering your tools, and welcoming wildlife preserve-wide. They don’t come easy. Find them all in the new Achievements menu (press K) — recent unlocks rise to the top. Next, a quick tour of your other menus →
star.touch: That’s the whole loop — and welcoming the grasshopper just earned your first achievement, ★ First Friend. There are 50 stars to discover across the preserve: for restoring each biome, bringing back top predators, mastering your tools, and welcoming wildlife preserve-wide. They don’t come easy. Find them all in the new Achievements menu (the star button) — recent unlocks rise to the top. Next, a quick tour of your other menus →

goals.title: Your goals
goals.text: The board on the left, under the meadow's health, is your goal list. There are ten starter goals to work through, three on the board at a time — finish one to claim its reward and the next takes its place. When all ten are done, you set your own goals and play the preserve your way.
goals.touch: The board on the left, under the meadow's health, is your goal list. There are ten starter goals to work through, three on the board at a time — finish one to claim its reward and the next takes its place. When all ten are done, you set your own goals and play the preserve your way.

home.title: Make yourself at home
home.text: Last thing — walk back to your camp tent and press E to step inside. The sign by the tent first builds your tent into a real house (each style has its own perk), then upgrades it along four tracks: Space (a bigger home that lets you carry more), Comfort (strengthens your house perk), Decor, and Light. Higher upgrades open as your biomes get healthier, and inside you can place crafted camp comforts. Step in now — the preserve is all yours. Happy restoring!
home.touch: Last thing — walk back to your camp tent and tap it to step inside. The sign by the tent first builds your tent into a real house (each style has its own perk), then upgrades it along four tracks: Space (a bigger home that lets you carry more), Comfort (strengthens your house perk), Decor, and Light. Higher upgrades open as your biomes get healthier, and inside you can place crafted camp comforts. Step in now — the preserve is all yours. Happy restoring!

tutorial.demoNote: This is the free demo — restore the meadow to unlock the forest, then explore. The demo wraps up 10 minutes after the forest opens.

menus.title: Your menus, up top
menus.text: Up top on the right are your menus, grouped by purpose: Learn (field journal, achievements, feed), Build (basket, crafting, tools, goals), World (map, weather), and System (Settings, Help). Each one explains itself the first time you open it.
menus.touch: Up top on the right are your menus, grouped by purpose: Learn (journal, achievements, feed), Build (basket, crafting, tools, goals), World (map, weather), and System (Settings, Help). Each one explains itself the first time you open it.

toolbelt.title: Your toolbelt
toolbelt.text: Your toolbelt sits at the bottom: 1 basket to gather, 2 shovel to shape soil, 3 watering can for water. Press T to open Tools & Upgrades — spend materials to level each one up, and to write up the field guide for the area you’re standing in. Some upgrades open up as a biome gets healthier, so check back as you go.
toolbelt.touch: Your toolbelt sits at the bottom: basket to gather, shovel to shape soil, watering can for water. Tap the tools button to open Tools & Upgrades — spend materials to level each one up, and to write up the field guide for the area you’re standing in. Some upgrades open up as a biome gets healthier, so check back as you go.

navigate.title: Find your way around
navigate.text: Get your bearings. Top-left tracks this meadow — health, balance, animals home, plus the current weather and season. Press H anytime for help.
navigate.touch: Get your bearings. Top-left tracks this meadow — health, balance, animals home, plus the current weather and season. Tap the ? button anytime for help.

moreAnimals.title: Bring the meadow home
moreAnimals.text: Food, water, and shelter placed close together bring more animals back. Check your journal (J) for what each one needs. The meadow's in good hands!
moreAnimals.touch: Food, water, and shelter placed close together bring more animals back. Check your journal for what each one needs. The meadow's in good hands!

help.title: How to Play
help.intro: A gentle loop: gather materials, craft them into habitat, place it on the land, and welcome wildlife home.

gather.title: Gather
gather.text: Collect branches, seeds, stones, and flowers from glowing spots. They regrow on their own.

store.title: Store
store.text: Stash spare materials in chests — crafting can still use them from anywhere.

craft.title: Craft
craft.text: Press C to turn materials into habitat. New recipes unlock as a biome recovers.

rebuild.title: Rebuild
rebuild.text: Place habitat to raise biome health; variety raises balance. Dig, water, and plant with the shovel and can.

welcome.title: Welcome them back
welcome.text: When the habitat fits, the animal returns on its own. Click it to observe it.

record.title: Record & grow
record.text: Your field journal fills in with every return. Upgrade tools to reach harder habitats.

weather.title: Weather
weather.text: Each biome's weather drifts through the seasons — a few materials and animals only appear in the right conditions.

board.title: Set your own goals
board.text: The board points to your next milestone. Add goals of your own with G.

keys.interact: Interact — gather, open chests, craft, doors
keys.click: Observe an animal · open a placed item’s menu (move / rotate / pick up)
keys.shiftClick: Instantly pick a placed object back up
keys.rotate: Rotate the object you’re placing or moving a quarter-turn
keys.toolSelect: Select a tool: basket, shovel, watering can, paint (paint works in your home)
keys.tasks: Tuck away / show the goal board
keys.goals: Open the goals builder — design your own task list
keys.help: Open this How to Play guide

help.demoNote: You're playing the free demo — restore the meadow to open the forest, then explore it. The demo wraps up 10 minutes after the forest opens, and your save carries into the full game.

animals.title: Bringing more animals
animals.text: Each needs food, water, and shelter placed close together. The journal (J) lists what each animal needs.

home.title: Your home
home.text: Decorate your tent with crafted comforts, and build or upgrade it from the sign nearby.

tools.title: Tools & upgrades
tools.text: Press T to spend materials on a bigger basket, stronger tools, and new field guides.

land.title: Heal the land
land.text: Dig a bed (2), water it (3), then plant — or water it again to flood a pond, river, or lake.

goals.title: Your Goals
goals.intro: Play the preserve your way. Pick something to work toward — a specific build, things to plant, a material to gather, animals to read up on, or restoring your home or a whole biome — and it shows on the board with live progress. Finishing one grants a small bundle of materials.
goals.empty: No goals of your own yet — pick a type below to add one.
goals.rewardNote: Finishing any goal grants a small bundle of materials — claim it on the board.
goals.moreNote: You can hold 3 goals at a time — 6 once the whole preserve is unlocked. Tip: you can also add a goal for a specific animal from its field-journal entry, or a specific item to craft from the crafting menu — look for the target button.
goals.startersIntro: Your goals live here. To begin with, the preserve sets them for you: ten starter goals that show you around, three on the board at a time. Finish one to claim its reward and the next takes its place. Once you’ve worked through all ten, this is where you design your own.
goals.unlockHint: Once you finish these, you'll be able to set goals of your own.
goals.limitReached: You're holding all {max} goals at once. Finish or remove one to add another.

desc.craft: Craft a set number of a specific item — e.g. 3 bird baths. Hover the finished goal to see the materials it needs.
desc.plant: Plant a number of living things (flowers, grasses, trees) anywhere in the preserve.
desc.collect: Gather a set amount of one material, like 20 seeds or 10 stones.
desc.observe: Read about a number of animals in your field journal.
desc.welcomeTotal: Welcome a number of new animals back across the whole preserve.
desc.home: Upgrade one of your home's tracks (Space, Comfort, Decor, Light) toward a higher level.
desc.homeBuild: Your home is still a tent — pick a house style below to make it your goal. Its ⓘ shows the materials each style needs.
desc.tool: Upgrade one of your tools to its next tier. Only tools you can't already afford show up — its ⓘ lists the materials it needs.
desc.unlock: Open a specific biome. Each one has its own requirements — see the checklist on the board.
desc.health: Heal an unlocked biome up to a target health — the late-game capstone for a place you love.
desc.biomeAnimals: Welcome every animal that belongs in one unlocked biome — a full food web, top to bottom.

goals.homeMaxed: Your {track} upgrade is already at the top — pick another track.
goals.affordableNote: You already have the materials for that — just craft it.

joinApproval.error: Could not respond to that request

joinWaiting.denied: {host} didn’t let you into {world} this time. You can still play your own solo preserve, or head back.
joinWaiting.ready: Your character’s ready! {host} just needs to let you in to {world}. This page will open the world the moment they approve.

coach.label: Tip
coach.home: Welcome home — your own cozy space to make yours. Decorate it with comforts you craft, and use the sign by your tent to build and upgrade it (a bigger home even lets you carry more). New upgrades open as your biomes recover.
coach.journal: Field journal — every animal that can live in an area and what each needs to return. Your checklist for what to build.
coach.achievements: Achievements — 50 stars to earn for restoring biomes, mastering tools, and welcoming wildlife across the preserve.
coach.feed: Activity feed — a running log of everything that happens, including these tips. Scroll back anytime.
coach.inventory: Basket — what you're carrying right now. It has a limit, so stash spare materials in a chest.
coach.crafting: Crafting — turn gathered materials into habitat to place on the land. New recipes unlock as a biome recovers.
coach.tools: Tools & upgrades — spend materials on a bigger basket, stronger shovel and watering can, and new field guides.
coach.goals: Goals — set your own tasks (craft, plant, attract an animal, restore a biome) and track them on the board.
coach.biomes: The Preserve — each area's progress, what's needed to open the next, and fast-travel to places you've visited.
coach.weather: Weather & seasons — how conditions shift across the preserve and shape the land; some materials and animals only appear in the right weather.
coach.settings: Settings — sound, accessibility, your character, and save options.
coach.demoNear: One more animal and you'll complete the demo — you're nearly there!
